mechanism: Rasagiline (MAO-B inhibitor) may potentiate the systemic effects of timolol, particularly cardiovascular effects, and there is theoretical risk of hypertensive crisis if timolol is absorbed systemically and interacts with rasagiline's monoamine oxidase inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; use timolol ophthalmic with caution in patients on rasagiline; ensure proper ophthalmic administration technique to minimize systemic absorption.
